# Docs

- Garage: Underground lifts & terminals
  - [Getting Started](/garage): Install Evolent Garage on your server.
  - [Configuration](/garage/Config): Every option in config.lua, with its default and limits.
  - [Garage Manager](/garage/Manager): Create and manage garages, the brand and the settings in game.
  - [Using Garages](/garage/Usage): How players collect and store vehicles, and how lost vehicles are recovered.

  - **Reference**
  - [Commands](/garage/Commands): All in-game commands.
  - [Exports](/garage/Exports): Functions other resources can use.
  - [Frameworks](/garage/Frameworks): Supported frameworks and how to customize a bridge.
- Boosting: Vehicle boosting contracts
  - [Getting Started](/boosting): Install Evolent Boosting on your server.
  - [Configuration](/boosting/Config): The out of the box configuration for Evolent Boosting.
  - [Custom Missions](/boosting/Missions): Create your own mission steps and link them to missions in game.
  - [Commands](/boosting/Commands): All console and in-game commands.
  - [Exports](/boosting/Exports): Functions other resources can use to work with player progression and the UI.
  - [Types](/boosting/Types): The main data structures used throughout the resource.

  - **Integrations**
  - [FD Laptop](/boosting/Integrations/Fd_laptop): Run the boosting UI as an app on the FD Laptop.
  - [RAHE Boosting Migration](/boosting/Integrations/Rahe_boosting): Move your players' progression from RAHE Boosting to Evolent Boosting.
- Fleamarket: Player driven marketplace
  - [Getting Started](/fleamarket): Install Evolent Fleamarket on your server.
  - [Configuration](/fleamarket/Config): The out of the box configuration for Evolent Fleamarket.
- Skills: Player skill progression
  - [Getting Started](/skills): Install Evolent Skills, a free and open source skill system.

  - **Exports**
  - [Server Exports](/skills/Functions/Server): Add, remove and read player skill XP and levels.
  - [Client Exports](/skills/Functions/Client): Read the local player's skills from another resource.
